newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-PACERS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK AUSTIN CROSHERE.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-PACERS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK AUSTIN CROSHERE.

text.p: The Indiana Pacers Thursday announced the signing of their first-round draft pick, forward Austin Croshere, who was the 12th overall selection in the 1997 NBA draft.
The former Providence star is the highest pick from last week's draft to come to terms with the NBA team that selected him. Ed Gray, the 22nd overall pick, signed with the Atlanta Hawks last Friday.
Croshere averaged 17.9 points per game this past season with the Friars and boosted his numbers to 22.8 points and 5.8 rebounds in the NCAA Tournament.
Croshere, who was coveted by new Pacers head coach Larry Bird, helped Providence advance to the regional finals before losing to eventual champions Arizona.

The 6-foot-9 (2.05 m) Croshere is an excellent free-throw shooter who made 89 percent of his shots from the line as a senior and 84.3 percent overall in his collegiate career. He also improved his scoring average each season.
The Pacers hired the legendary Bird, an Indiana native and former superstar with the Boston Celtics, as their coach in May after Larry Brown left to coach the Philadelphia 76ers.
